_doc: Single Pearl script commands changed or dropped by the story generator (b2tools/pearl_story.py FileTr.translate, script_patches()): Pearl script file -> command address (hex) -> {'args': the command's new arguments (the same command, translated as usual), or 'drop': why it goes}; each with 'why'. Keep this short: Pearl's scripts are translated as they are otherwise.

89._why: The Underground Man (Eterna; notes/UNDERGROUND.md section 8, the lead 2026-10-26): digging and Spheres are not built, so after the first trip down his missions go on with the Secret Base (var 0x40B6 = 3; notes/SECRET_BASES.md): his next test, then decorating and Flags, each with Pearl's goods; the first mission's reward is three Underground Traps, which do not exist here.

0x171.why: mission 1 done (var 0x40B6 = 1): his Secret Base mission (0x02D3) instead of mission 2 (0x0237, digging)

0x208.drop: no Underground Traps (first of the mission-1 reward's three GiveUndergroundTrap calls)

0x22c.why: after the first trip down: line 29 in place of line 7 (what Traps are)

358._why: The Battle Tower (notes/BATTLE_ZONE.md, the lead 2026-11-01): no wireless Multi, so the Multi receptionist doesn't ask about a friend and goes on to a partner in the tower

0x85d.drop: Would you like to communicate with a friend?
